text: This is such a polished app that has smooth mechanics, clear and intuitive UI, and is like a much cuter and more customizable pomodoro where you can have focus sessions as low as 5 minutes to 120 minutes, and also customize if you want to be able to interact with your phone during it without losing progress (which would be essential for focus tasks where you might need your phone, so it was really smart of them to include that!). I also love the decorating and collecting aspect!!
author: Hannah G.

text: This app is incredible and exactly what I needed. It's easy to pick up the phone and get lost in scrolling, but every time I see my bean knitting I smile and get back on task.
